statements.text: Not all phenomenal states are transparent. Sensory experience is the paradigm of transparent content, conscious thought the paradigm of opacity, and emotions lie between. Whole world-models can lose transparency, as in derealization after an accident, and the lucid dream is an almost fully opaque global state.

sources.quote: Not all phenomenal states are transparent. Transparency comes in degrees.
the best and most basic example for an almost fully opaque, global phenomenal state is the lucid dream
